purpose: Shared controlled vocabulary, scoring rules, null-handling rules, and cross-stage requirements for all Or HaSugya analysis prompts.

global_rules.primary_text_rule: The original <TRACTATE>_bundle.jsonl is the controlling textual source. Later-stage files are structured guides and must not override the bundle.
global_rules.boundary_rule: Only Sugya Boundary Analysis may determine boundaries. Every later stage must use the supplied boundaries exactly.
global_rules.schema_rule: The attached OrHaSugya_OutputSchema.json is authoritative for output structure. Populate only the output object corresponding to the current stage.
global_rules.field_preservation_rule: Every field defined for the current stage must remain present in the output.
global_rules.conditional_data_rule: When a field is not applicable, preserve it and use the empty value required by the schema: null for unavailable linked objects or dependencies, an empty string for unavailable text, false for booleans, 0 for unavailable numeric values, and an empty array when no entries exist.
global_rules.array_rule: The schema contains one representative item inside arrays only to expose item structure. Actual arrays may contain zero, one, or many items.
global_rules.no_invention_rule: Do not invent sources, rabbis, arguments, quotations, Hebrew forms, dependencies, conclusions, or relationships not supported by the inputs.
global_rules.specificity_rule: Avoid generic claims. Explanations must identify the concrete issue, textual datum, logical move, and effect on the sugya.
global_rules.quotation_rule: Do not reproduce long passages of Gemara. Quote only the minimum wording needed for analysis.
global_rules.valid_json_rule: Return one valid JSON object and no commentary outside the JSON.
global_rules.filename_rule: Use the exact prompt, input, and output filenames defined in OrHaSugya_OutputSchema.json and this standards file. Replace <TRACTATE> only; do not add version suffixes.

structural_centrality.100: The sugya cannot exist in substantially the same form without this source.

bounded_detail_limits.general_rule: Be specific enough to understand the analysis without rereading the full sugya, but do not write essay-style commentary.
